# skill.supply

> skill.supply is a free AI career agent and talent transfer market for job seekers. It turns an evidence-based background into positioning, five target companies, an ATS-friendly resume, and a draft opening message.

Operator: Adam Pangelinan
Canonical site: https://skill.supply/
Source: https://github.com/adamtpang/skill.supply

## Use this site when

- A job seeker needs to package real experience without inventing claims.
- A person wants public company research, live role discovery, or an application packet they review before submission.
- A crawler needs the current offer, operator, privacy flow, or contact path.

## Key pages

- Home and career agent: https://skill.supply/
- Company research: https://skill.supply/companies
- Application packet builder: https://skill.supply/apply
- About: https://skill.supply/about
- Contact: https://skill.supply/contact
- Privacy: https://skill.supply/privacy
- Sitemap: https://skill.supply/sitemap.xml

## Current commercial status

The price for job seekers is $0. skill.supply has no paid candidate plan, trial, checkout, or placement guarantee. Company-side talent work is handled separately at https://darktalent.tech/.

## Data and automation boundaries

Direct report runs use a user-supplied Anthropic API key. An optional free queue stores the submitted background while a local worker prepares the report; the Privacy page explains current retention. Shareable reports are encoded in the URL fragment. skill.supply does not offer a public API or MCP server, and it does not submit applications or send messages for users.
